recipes.title: 3 cup chicken
steps: Heat wok, add peanut & sesame oil.
Fry ginger & garlic till golden (10 min).
Add chicken, medium-high heat.
Add rock sugar to melt.
Add rice wine.
Add soy sauce, chilli, a splash of sesame oil, and water. Cover for 8-10 min.
Add basil, stir, and serve.

recipes.title: Adobo Chicken without Adobo Seasoning
steps: Marinate chicken (optional, not a must).
Fry chicken with oil.
Remove chicken.
Fry garlic & onion.
Add chicken, stock, and all ingredients except green onion / cilantro.
Low simmer, cover for 30 min.
Flip chicken & open lid, reduce for 25 min.

recipes.title: Adobo Chicken
steps: Season chicken with salt & pepper. Sauté setting, 7 min.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaf, onion, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper.
Pressure cook on high 8 min, then remove bay leaf.
Reduce sauce 20 min.
Add scallions.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken thigh
steps: Season chicken and bake at 425°F for 25 min.

recipes.title: Chicken thigh with fishball sauce
steps: Debone chicken thigh.
Marinate with 1 tbsp peanut fishball sauce, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine.
Marinate overnight.
Cook in pan. Done.

recipes.title: Chinese Chicken Thigh
ingredients: 1 tbsp sweet soy sauce / soy sauce
steps: Marinate the chicken.
Pan fry on medium heat.
Finish on high heat.

recipes.title: Chinese Stuff Chicken
ingredients: Lotus seeds & lily bulb (蓮子百合), a little, soaked 3 hr
steps: Wash the glutinous rice.
Keep the abalone juice & mushroom soaking water.
Mix 1 tbsp oyster sauce + 1 tsp dark soy sauce.
Mix in lotus seed & lily bulb; cut mushroom and abalone and mix in.
Mix in Chinese bacon.
Mix the rice together.
Plate the rice; add chestnut on top.
Add salted egg yolk on top.
Steam the rice ~40 min.
Clean and debone the chicken (cut the leg, remove the bone).
Marinate chicken with 4 tbsp fresh soy sauce for a few hours (~3 hr).
Stuff the hot rice into the chicken; use a skewer to secure.
Hold the chicken's shape (not completely flat on the plate).
Steam the chicken 35 min.

recipes.title: Jer Jer Chicken Pot
steps: Marinate the wings 20 min with salt, sugar, soy sauce, oyster sauce, salt-baked chicken powder, and a little oil.
Fry chicken wings till golden on each side.
Remove wings.
In a pot, add oil, ginger, chopped shallot, and garlic.
Fry till fragrant.
Add chicken wings on top, pour in a round of cooking wine, cover 3-4 min. Done.

recipes.title: scallion oil hand rip chicken
steps: In a heating wok, use a bowl upside down; put chicken leg, ginger, and goji berry on top. Steam for 25 min.
Remove chicken and rip into pieces.
Mince garlic & scallion.
Heat up oil (can make scallion oil if you want).
Add oil to garlic & scallion.
Add salt, soy sauce, and a little sugar.
Add chicken broth from the bowl to the sauce.
Put sauce over chicken & serve.

recipes.title: Skewer Chicken
steps: Cut chicken into 2-inch pieces.
Mix the spices with oil and chicken. Marinate 15 min+.
Skewer on bamboo skewers.
Air fry on parchment paper: 10 min at 400°F.
Flip and cook at 400°F for 8 min (or more if needed).
Make butter sauce: melt butter with chopped garlic, parsley, crushed red pepper, and a touch of honey over low heat.
Brush with sauce & serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Chicken Pot
steps: Chop the chicken into pieces.
Soak in salt water 5 min, rinse, and soak/drain 3-4 times. Drain completely.
Season chicken: salt 1/3 tsp, soy sauce 1 tsp, sugar 1/2 tbsp, oyster sauce 1 tbsp, cornstarch 1 tbsp. Mix and marinate 15 min.
Prepare 3 tablespoons of the spicy packet.
Wok with oil, fry chicken; don't move it, 1 min then flip. Lock in the chicken juice.
Remove chicken.
Fry onion, pepper, garlic, and shallot.
Add spicy sauce and fry the sauce on large heat.
Add some cooking wine.
Add chicken, 30 sec.
Add water (not too much), low heat, cover the wok, 2 min. Test flavor (can add 1 tbsp oyster sauce).
Large heat 1 min to reduce.
Transfer to a small pot.
Add rice wine and let it bubble.

recipes.title: steam chicken with chinese sausage
steps: After slicing & cleaning, marinate chicken with the sauce above. Mix well.
Add sliced Chinese sausage to the mix.
Optional: add mushroom if wanted.
Cook rice first (can cook with 1 pc Chinese sausage).
When rice is cooked, take out and put on a plate, then plate the chicken on top and steam for 11 min.
Serve; add sweet soy sauce if needed.
